title: The European festival circuit and its value to musicians
summary: Festivals in Holland, Germany, England, Nice and Berne, which he helped start, give American musicians steady work.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Something around in there - yeah - and, then, there was another--- well, I want to mention too that these festivals in Europe - like in Holland and there are German festivals; there's English festivals now-- and it certainly had done great by American musicians and there's the one in France---
But, just think how many American musicians had a job--
Well, the 'Berne one is something -- I helped start---

But these are all things that are bringing over American Musicians -- every year and some musicians I would say today in America that are lucky enough to play all the festivals here and all the festivals in Europe, still have to work so hard all year round -- they can make enough money to coast without killing themselves and I think this new interest in festivals is very good for jazz musicians.
And, especially the ones that have some sort of a name---
Who are some of the musicians that go to Europe now - Kenny Davern goes and you go and Cliff Leeman goes and Ralph Sutton goes---
You could go on and on---
